outcome: Give Banking teams a working Regulatory Compliance & Policy Copilot (RegTech) capability on their own data — it compresses audit-preparation from weeks to hours.
overview: Gulf regulators issue hundreds of circulars a year, and compliance teams read every one of them by hand — scarce legal and compliance hours spent on tracking rather than judgement, with gaps surfacing only at audit. The Regulatory Compliance & Policy Copilot indexes circulars alongside the bank's own policies and control library, answers a compliance question with the citation behind it, and flags where policy has not yet caught up with a new requirement. Every answer is traceable to source and its lineage recorded. The copilot informs the compliance officer; it does not issue a compliance opinion. Four weeks on the bank's own document set establishes whether audit-preparation time actually falls.
